summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Brookstone Dividend Stock ETF (BAMD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively selects income-producing US stocks or ETFs based on external and internal research. It selects both mid- to large-cap securities. BAMD was launched on Sep 28, 2023 and is issued by Brookstone.

holdings.infoBox: BAMD is an equity ETF with a total of 97 individual holdings. The top holdings are Paychex stock at 5.16%, JPMorgan Chase & Co. at 4.94%, ONEOK at 4.66%, Blackstone at 4.53%, and Eversource Energy at 4.40%.
